$description: Menu (platform/components/Menu), extended in library wave 5, lane B: the tokens of submenus (MenuSub). Radio items reuse the checkbox item's check; ContextMenu is placed by the floating foundation. The menu's own tokens stay in the shared set.

menu-sub-open-background.$description: MenuSub: the item whose submenu is open keeps the hover fill.

menu-sub-arrow-color.$description: MenuSub: the chevron's color, quieter than the label.

menu-sub-offset.$description: MenuSub: the submenu starts past the parent menu's edge (its padding and border), level with the item.

menu-sub-fallback-inset-block-start.$description: MenuSub without the top layer: level with the item.

menu-sub-fallback-inset-inline-start.$description: MenuSub without the top layer: at the item's end edge.
